title: Planning, step limits and stop criteria

videos.script: An agent that decides its own steps also needs something that decides when the steps stop. That is this lesson. {{title}} First, planning. The model writes its plan down, as a list with a status beside each step, and the host keeps it. A written plan can be read, checked and handed over. {{plan}} Then the budget. Steps, tokens and seconds, counted by the host before every request. The model is never asked whether it would like to stop. {{budget}} You will run the same task four times. Once with room to finish. Then with three steps, with fifteen hundred tokens, and with one second. Each run stops in a different place, and says why. {{runs}} A stopped run still owes somebody an answer. You will see what the host hands to a person, and one surprise: the plan says a step is not done, when its result is already in. {{handoff}} And you will watch a plan change when a tool fails. {{replan}}
